title: Polypiler spec document metadata
description: The metadata block every document under spec/<family>/ starts with (PRD §4.1), followed by the family body under 'spec'. polypiler-tooling spec validate also checks the rules a schema cannot state: the family prefix of 'id', its uniqueness, tests of a normative document, review at the current version, the lifecycle order of 'introducedIn' and 'deprecatedIn', and that every test path exists in the repository.

id.description: <FAMILY>.<name>: FAMILY is the upper-cased family folder; unique across spec/.

tests.description: Repository-relative paths that must exist; at least one when status is normative.

deprecatedIn.description: Exactly when status is deprecated; not earlier than introducedIn.

compatibility.description: Impact of this version on the previous one; none at version 1.

reviewedRevision.description: 0 to version; a normative document is reviewed at its current version.

normative.description: The normative text, RFC 2119 keywords in capitals; non-empty unless status is draft.

spec.description: The family body; its schema is spec/schemas/<family>.schema.json.
